text.title: Outcome Based Roadmaps Advanced Procedure
text.summary: Step-by-step procedure for applying Outcome Based Roadmaps Advanced. Each step lists input, action, and output. Pause and surface the artefact when output is produced.

step.name: anchor-business-goal
step.action: Restate the goal as metric + current value + target + deadline so it can be falsified on a date.
step.decision-gate: If the goal cannot be stated in that form, stop — the horizon has no root to review against.

step.name: draw-multi-q-chain
step.action: Link outcomes across quarters with edges.

step.name: classify-dependencies
step.action: Per edge: classify hard/soft + write rationale.

step.name: apply-confidence-decay
step.action: Cap Q+3 at low unless cited evidence.

step.name: lane-portfolio
step.action: Assign each outcome to its product swim lane.

step.name: attach-causal-hypotheses
step.action: Write one sentence per outcome stating how it moves the goal.
step.output: each outcome carries a causal hypothesis
step.decision-gate: An outcome with no statable hypothesis is cut, not carried.

step.name: attach-leading-indicators
step.action: Name exactly one weekly-readable leading indicator per outcome.

step.name: design-experiments
step.action: List 2-4 experiments per outcome, each tagged with its outcome id and carrying success criteria written now, before the experiment runs.
step.decision-gate: An experiment with no parent outcome id or no pre-registered criteria does not enter the plan.

step.name: publish-and-quarter-review
step.action: Render the customer, board, engineering and sales views from the one source tree; publish; review at each quarter close.
step.output: public roadmap + four audience views + quarter_reviews

decision-gate.p: After step 9, the artefact MUST satisfy the output contract in content/02-output-contract.xml before downstream consumers read it.
